verifications.claim: The University of Denver (DU) Pioneers won their 11th NCAA national championship.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'could win an unprecedented 11th national championship'; R4: 'claim its record 10th national title, Pioneers freshman Johnny Hicks has done the same to capture No. 11', 'The Pioneers’ 11 titles are now two more than any other NCAA program.'
verifications.reasoning: R4 directly confirms the 11th championship win; R3 previews it as potential but context supports the outcome.

verifications.claim: The University of Denver (DU) Pioneers defeated Wisconsin 2-1 on April 11, 2026, in Las Vegas.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'suffered a 2-1 loss at T-Mobile Arena on Saturday, April 11', 'Denver 002 2, Wisconsin 100 1'; R4: '2-1 victory Saturday afternoon at T-Mobile Arena against Wisconsin.'

verifications.claim: The University of Denver (DU) Pioneers defeated Michigan 4-3 in double-overtime in the semifinal.
verifications.label: CLEAR

verifications.claim: Johnny Hicks made 49 saves in the semifinal.
verifications.label: CLEAR

verifications.claim: Johnny Hicks made 29 saves in the final.
